status: preregistered; no NN work done at freeze
question: Does placing identical novel numeric tokens in first vs second answer-word role in matched raw-01 AE1 teaching determine heldout second-word accuracy?
single_variable: Assignment of high IDs 6..14 to a (first answer word) or b (second answer word) in supplemental r2 teaching; base and all budgets held fixed

profile.name: SLE-AE1-n5-v1
profile.answer: first r complete 6bit data words + external S

data.base: a,b in 0..5, train iff (a+b)%6 not in {0,1}; both r=1,2; c=d=0
data.supplement: v in6..14,s in0..3; orientation HIGH_FIRST=(v,s), HIGH_SECOND=(s,v); r=2 only; c=d=0
data.heldout: v in6..14,s in4..5 (18 per orientation), r=2; never trained
data.nuisance: c,d=0 fixed in every condition; no suffix-generalization claim

primary: per-seed r2 exact on 18 heldout HIGH_SECOND (s4/5,v6..14), compare trained HIGH_SECOND vs HIGH_FIRST orientation
secondary: heldout HIGH_FIRST, seen supplemental in-role and crossed-role, base train/val/test, per-word accuracy, STOP location and high-bit activation
pre_run_gates: All 39-bit questions decode to legal 5-info-bit+terminal0 words, reserved END 111100, STOP external S only
Exactly base 24 train and 6 val/6 test pairs, plus 36 supplement train and 18 heldout per orientation
Same 948 teacher-prefix targets per epoch in both arms and identical seed-specific permutations and initial weights
New-word v6..14 appears equally often as target in either arm, once in first or second position per r2 supplement; target multiset differs in ordering, intended variable
Metrics and budget frozen before examining outputs; do not cherry-pick checkpoint/seed or extend budget
Interpret heldout results only if in-role train fit >=90% per arm, otherwise learning-capacity failure
interpretation_limits: This is a new fresh-model matched curriculum pilot, not a continuation of PR29 checkpoints; cannot attribute results to SLE versus other encodings
Swapping a/b position necessarily changes raw-question positions and target-prefix contexts: tests role-transfer under coupled position changes, not isolated latent representation
Two seeds only; descriptive, not statistical significance
No large-model teacher oracle; scripted math only generates labels offline

provenance.U: Small NN native-01 learning, math progression, generalization and causal controls
provenance.F: PR26 SLE-AE1-n5-v1; PR29 matched teaching implementation; PR34/35 post-hoc new b failure
provenance.A: A role-specific first vs second answer-word teaching effect may explain failed b>=6 transfer; not established
